'''2006 Rhode Island State Championship Casey Anis LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2006 Rhode Island State Championship]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Casey "spideyguy0" Anis (2006-07-03).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35620 Tat Mains post-errata pre-redux]. == Original post ==

'''Tat Mains post-errata pre-redux'''
* '''Author:''' Casey "spideyguy0" Anis
* '''Published:''' July 3, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is the Tat Mains deck I played at RI States yesterday. This deck has a window of like a month to be playable since it is between the starting interupt errata and the full redux set. Tatooine Jedi essentialy.

=== Strategy ===

This was much better when you could start the Slave Quarters but it still works. Grab Sai'Torr first action. Get a Jedi down first turn. If there's one in your hand put him down wherever he'll do the most good. If there isnt, pull Mace with his stick (use Sai'torr not Mace's game text) to the City Outskirts. If you have enough Force, instead pull LSJK with his stick, his hand and Lightsaber Proficiency. There are 4 cards that get the JCC out. You need this thing on the table. Once it comes out pull Yoda so that he can move your Council Members out of there once they deploy. 3PO is also big in this deck so thats why Padme and Shmi. Padme -> Shmi -> 3PO, so if you get any of them you're good and you dont have to run 3x 3PO. Alternatively Slave Quarters also pulls Shmi and its a twix. This deck also changes a bit depending on what you're expecting to see.

Scum, or other alien decks: Add The Camp and start it.

Combat: Start Civil Disorder instead of Rycar. If you know you're gonna see this matchup add extra Resilience, its huge because it can stop Sidious in duels or combat your opponent initiates.

I do have more to say but I always get bored writing these things. Ill add more if I have the chance.
